reason: The key comes from the STATUS_DATA table at the top of the file, which holds one literal key per insiders status.
conceptInfoKey is chosen by a useMemo in the same file from literal keys, one per concept and unlocked-exercise count combination.
The headline key comes from the HEADLINE table, which maps an iteration status to a literal key.
previousSessionsKey at the foot of the file builds an i18next plural key from the discussion counts.
